title: Dr. Mario (Classic NES)
sources: own knowledge of the NES original

rows: Move the capsule; Down drops faster

widgets.text: Line up four or more of the same colour (capsule halves or viruses) in a row or column to clear them. Clear every virus in the bottle to finish the level.
Red, yellow and blue viruses. Unsupported capsule halves fall after a clear: plan chains. Keep the top middle (the mouth) clear or the bottle fills.
Virus level 0-20 (4 to 84 viruses) and speed Low/Med/Hi; clearing a level adds four more viruses.
The next capsule is shown in Dr. Mario's hand: plan its spot while the current one falls.
Points are per virus cleared, multiplied by speed; several viruses in one drop score more.
After level 20 the game keeps going at the top level; the high score is kept per session.
